original.goal: Record yourself applying both management and leadership communication styles in a professional scenario.
original.title: Speaking Like a Manager and Like a Leader
original.body_en:
📹 Video Quiz

Title: Speaking Like a Manager and Like a Leader
Time: 1 hour
Objective: Record yourself applying both management and leadership communication styles in a professional scenario.

Your Task:

Record a 2–3 minute video where you complete these steps:

Introduce yourself as if you're leading a small team.

Example: "Hi, I'm [Name], and I'm supervising this week's project."

Give one instruction as a manager.

Example: "Please complete the draft report by Thursday at 5 PM. I'll review it Friday morning so we can deliver on time."

Motivate your team as a leader.

Example: "This report is important because it shows the client we are reliable and innovative. I appreciate the effort you've all put in, and I know together we can deliver something excellent."

Tips for Your Video:

🎤 Voice: Be clear, confident, and professional.

👀 Eye contact: Look directly at the camera.

💡 Lighting: Face a light source, avoid shadows.

📵 Background: Keep it simple and distraction-free.

🕒 Length: Aim for 2–3 minutes.

Why This Matters:

This activity builds the ability to switch between management tone (clear, structured, direct) and leadership tone (motivating, inspiring, inclusive). Both are essential in U.S. workplaces.

Optional AI Practice:

Use ChatGPT in voice mode. Give your manager-style instruction and leader-style motivation. Then ask:

"How was my clarity?"

"Did my tone sound motivating?"

"What can I improve?"

Once you have made your video, upload your result to your Google Classroom at the following link:

https://classroom.google.com/c/NzgzNjY5MDgwMDkx/a/ODAyNTU0MTk3MjM1/details
original.body_es:
📹 Cuestionario en Video

Título: Hablando como un Gerente y como un Líder  
Tiempo: 1 hora  
Objetivo: Grábate aplicando estilos de comunicación tanto de gestión como de liderazgo en un escenario profesional.

Tu Tarea:

Graba un video de 2 a 3 minutos donde completes estos pasos:

Preséntate como si estuvieras liderando un pequeño equipo.

Ejemplo: "Hi, I'm [Name], and I'm supervising this week's project."

Da una instrucción como gerente.

Ejemplo: "Please complete the draft report by Thursday at 5 PM. I'll review it Friday morning so we can deliver on time."

Motiva a tu equipo como líder.

Ejemplo: "This report is important because it shows the client we are reliable and innovative. I appreciate the effort you've all put in, and I know together we can deliver something excellent."

Consejos para tu Video:

🎤 Voz: Sé claro, seguro y profesional.

👀 Contacto visual: Mira directamente a la cámara.

💡 Iluminación: Enfréntate a una fuente de luz, evita sombras.

📵 Fondo: Mantenlo simple y sin distracciones.

🕒 Duración: Apunta a 2-3 minutos.

Por Qué Esto Importa:

Esta actividad desarrolla la habilidad de alternar entre un tono de gestión (claro, estructurado, directo) y un tono de liderazgo (motivador, inspirador, inclusivo). Ambos son esenciales en los lugares de trabajo en EE.UU.

Práctica Opcional con IA:

Usa ChatGPT en modo de voz. Da tu instrucción al estilo gerente y tu motivación al estilo líder. Luego pregunta:

"How was my clarity?"

"Did my tone sound motivating?"

"What can I improve?"

Una vez que hayas hecho tu video, sube tu resultado a tu Google Classroom en el siguiente enlace:

https://classroom.google.com/c/NzgzNjY5MDgwMDkx/a/ODAyNTU0MTk3MjM1/details
